subject: Approval request: headcount authorization & offer guidance for GRC + SecEng
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: headcount authorization & offer guidance for GRC + SecEng

Team —

Requesting quick authorization to move forward with two hires we discussed in the FY27 planning loop:

- 1x Senior Manager, Governance, Risk & Controls (GRC) — to lead policy and SOC2 readiness (cost center 41-SEC-GRC)
- 1x Senior Security Engineer (backend/infra focus) — to support Dedicated/private deployment hardening (cost center 41-SEC-ENG)

Attached: high-level headcount case (FY27_headcount_case_GRC-SecEng.pdf), proposed comp bands (comp-band-proposal_GRC.xlsx), and an initial candidate brief for Sam Park (candidate_summary_SamuelPark.pdf).

As a reminder of constraints: FY27 hiring budget has a hard cap for security of $1.4M (salary + burden). We have ~0.25FTE of unallocated spend left in the security bucket; this request requires a ~1.8FTE delta (we plan to backfill later roles from Q1 reductions).

Ask:
1) Marcus — please confirm we can reallocate ~0.9FTE from the infra hiring freeze to cover the Senior Security Engineer base in FY27. If not possible, indicate shortfall and alternative funding routes.
2) Marissa — confirm comp band alignment and whether we can offer a sign-on equity mix at the proposed level for Senior Manager GRC (range shown in attachment).
3) Evelyn — executive approval for headcount + any constraints on titles/levels (we proposed M3 for GRC and E5 for SecEng).

Timeline: target offer to candidate Sam Park by next Friday (9/10) if approvals come through. Sam has an external offer that expires 9/14 and is asking for an expedited process.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- FY27_headcount_case_GRC-SecEng.pdf (pdf)
- comp-band-proposal_GRC.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- candidate_summary_SamuelPark.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: headcount authorization & offer guidance for GRC + SecEng

Olga —

Thanks for the packet. Quick read and comments:

- I can free up ~0.6FTE by reprioritizing two infra requisitions (they're low maturity). That gets us partway there.
- To reach the 1.8FTE delta you flagged, we'd need either: (a) an additional 0.6FTE from central contingency (we have ~$80k left), or (b) move the Senior Manager hire into late Q1 to spread cost into FY28.
- Comp bands: the proposed ranges look reasonable but the midpoint for E5 SecEng is at top-end of our FY27 plan. If you need to be competitive for Sam, we should be prepared to offer at the 65th percentile and include a 10% sign-on cash if equity is constrained.

Action: I tentatively approve 0.6FTE reallocation today. If Marissa confirms we can compress equity for the GRC manager (more cash, less RSU in year 1), I'm comfortable authorizing a one-off sign-on payment from central contingency and pushing recruitment to extend the offer window.

Marcus
VP, Finance — Cloud Platforms
Redwood Inference

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: headcount authorization & offer guidance for GRC + SecEng

Olga / Marcus —

HR has reviewed the comp band proposal and candidate brief. Notes:

- GRC Senior Manager (M3) band: total cash range shown in comp-band-proposal_GRC.xlsx is acceptable. We can structure as 60% salary / 40% RSU vesting over 4 years. For internal compression, we recommend limiting base to the 55-60th percentile and supplementing with performance bonus in year one.
- SecEng (E5): candidate Sam Park's target base is at the 68th percentile for market. If we offer cash to match, equity will need to be at market median. Alternatively, we can offer a one-time sign-on cash up to 10% of base and keep equity at median.
- People Ops can field the offer and expedite background checks if Marcus signs off on the partial contingency funding.

I will prepare the formal offer templates (title, band, comp mix) for each role. I can also attach the redlined offer language for equity cliffs and relocation.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this reply (see earlier docs)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 13:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: headcount authorization & offer guidance for GRC + SecEng

Thanks —

Executive note: approve hiring request with the following conditions:

1) Extend the GRC Senior Manager start window to no earlier than 11/1 to balance FY27 spend unless the candidate has a competing offer that needs earlier acceptance.
2) For the SecEng role, if Sam's current counter requires exceeding the E5 band midpoint by >12%, do not match; offer the 10% sign-on cash and express strong career growth / accelerated promotion path in writing.
3) Require a two-week onboarding plan (security posture deliverables) in the offer packet for the SecEng role so we can measure early 90-day impact.

Marcus — please confirm final funding pathway and note any impact to other hiring freezes. Marissa — prepare offer templates reflecting 10% sign-on cash option and the 90-day deliverables clause.

Evelyn
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary / next steps: 

- Marcus confirmed reallocation of 0.6FTE and approval to use up to $70k from central contingency for sign-on if needed.
- Evelyn gave executive approval with conditions (start date flexibility for GRC; sign-on cap / 90-day deliverable for SecEng).
- Marissa will prepare two offer packages and route to me for final sign-off before People Ops issues the DocuSign envelope.

Kate / Sam (external): we expect to issue Sam an expedited offer by Monday morning (9/6). Sam — please confirm any constraints around relocation or visa timing; People Ops will follow up with a short checklist.

Links / artifacts: hiring case + comp bands (linked in prior email), HR ticket HR-TICKET-4782.

Olga
